identity.title: OpenUSD
identity.subTitle: Part 1: Binding
introduction: OpenUSD (Universal Scene Description) is an open, extensible framework for describing, composing, simulating and collaborating on three-dimensional scenes. Its scene graph is assembled from layers that compose into a single stage, so several authors and tools contribute to one scene without rewriting it. A stage is a hierarchy of prims, each carrying typed attributes and relationships, addressed by a canonical prim path.

OpenUSD is governed by the Alliance for OpenUSD (AOUSD), which publishes the OpenUSD Core Specification. The Core Specification covers paths, composition, layers and identity; the domain schemas that describe geometry, materials, lighting, skeletons and physics are versioned separately with the OpenUSD software releases.

Industrial visualization pairs OpenUSD with live process data. This document defines how an OPC UA Server declares that pairing as part of its own address space, so that any conforming connector can apply it without prior knowledge of the domain model.

_comment_citedAs: How sibling documents name this one.
_comment_dropParagraphsContaining: Paragraphs about the repository rather than the model. A submitted specification does not cite its own source tree.
_comment_annexMap: Old annex letter -> new. Bare `Annex X` citations carry no section sign, so they need their own map; getting this wrong silently retargets a reference at a real but unrelated annex, which no checker can see.
_comment_xrefMap: Applied to every section reference in the restructured markdown and in every sibling document that cites this one. Longest key wins.
_comment_foreignAnchors: Names this document uses for other documents. A section reference anchored on one of them belongs to that document and is left exactly as written.
